definisi_verbatim: PR is a useful metric that shows how closely a PV system is operating in relation to its ideal rated operation. PR indicates the total losses from the system output due to both array temperature and system component inefficiencies or failures, including the BOS components. PR is the ratio of actual energy output to the available solar energy that can be produced from the PV array at STC efficiency.
komponen_losses: Capture Losses (Lc = Yr - YA: suhu tropis 40-60°C, soiling debu kota, sudut datang foton) + System Losses (Ls = YA - Yf: susut efisiensi inverter DC-AC, rugi resistansi kabel/koneksi)
justifikasi_iklim_tropis_indonesia: Pengujian empiris 2 tahun di Cirata (Jawa Barat) pada modul crystalline silicon (c-Si rooftop 5 kW) menghasilkan nilai PR rata-rata harian 79.8% (~80%). Benchmark ini menegaskan bahwa Performance Ratio 80% (0.80) adalah batas konversi energi AC bersih realistis untuk modul c-Si di Jabodetabek setelah derating termal dan susut BOS.
penerbit_tahun: International Journal of Technology (IJTech) Universitas Indonesia, 2019

definisi_verbatim: The final yield, Yf, is defined as the annual, monthly, or daily net AC energy output in kWh, Eac, of the PV system per installed rated power, Prated. The final yield can be used to compare PV plants with different systems operating in different climates.
komponen_losses: Net AC delivered to grid / building switchboard
justifikasi_iklim_tropis_indonesia: Menggambarkan hasil panen energi listrik bersih AC riil per kWp kapasitas terpasang per hari di wilayah lintang khatulistiwa Indonesia.
penerbit_tahun: International Journal of Technology (IJTech) Universitas Indonesia, 2019

definisi_verbatim: The reference yield in kWh/kWp, Yr, is the total amount of available in-plane solar irradiance in kWh/m2, Hi, divided by the reference irradiance, Gi,ref, of 1,000 W/m2. If the reporting period is equal to one day, then Yr would be the equivalent number of sun hours at the reference irradiance per day.
komponen_losses: Radiasi surya bidang miring (Plane of Array / POA) tanpa kerugian
justifikasi_iklim_tropis_indonesia: Identik dengan Peak Sun Hours (PSH) fotogrametri Google Solar API Jabodetabek yang berada pada rentang 1.300–1.630 jam/tahun (rata-rata 4.46 jam/hari).
penerbit_tahun: International Journal of Technology (IJTech) Universitas Indonesia, 2019

definisi_verbatim: To approximately convert PVWatts V5 system loss to a PVWatts V1 DC-to-AC derate factor: 1. Convert the system loss to a derate: 1 - 14/100 = 0.86. 2. Multiply this value by the nominal inverter efficiency: 0.86 * 0.96 = 0.825.
komponen_losses: Soiling (2%), Shading (3%), Mismatch (2%), Wiring (2%), Connections (0.5%), LID (1.5%), Availability (3%), Inverter (4%)
justifikasi_iklim_tropis_indonesia: Memvalidasi bahwa standar konversi energi fotovoltaik modern secara internasional menetapkan faktor pengali AC riil pada rentang 80%–82.5% dari kapasitas DC puncak.
penerbit_tahun: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), U.S. Department of Energy, 2014
